title: Tabletop Tasks - A Meta-Game for Game Night
goal: Be the first to complete all your tasks!
tasks: Play a game with two different groups of people. (At least half of the players have to be different between the two games.)
Place in the top half of a game you play in. (Example: If there are 4 players in the game, end up in 1st or 2nd place.)
Play a game you've never played before, or play a game you own.
Roll the highest number on a single die as part of normal gameplay.
Roll the lowest number on a single die as part of normal gameplay.
Play at least three unique games during the event.
Play a game with someone you've never met before.
Play an entire game where you never miss noticing when it's your turn.
how_to_play: Each player gets 5 random tasks. Be the first to complete all your tasks to win!
Tap/click a card to mark it as completed or reset it.
Want to play the same card as a friend? Send them the link from the address bar.
